name: Ike's Love & Sandwiches
blocked: markup-suspect: DoorDash and UberEats (address-confirmed match, 3625 Midway Drive) agree with each other to the cent on every item, but that agreement is the known trap, not corroboration - both are ordering channels. allmenus (Grubhub-owned, independent of both) shows dramatically lower, internally-conventional prices for the same named/numbered sandwiches (18. Matt Cain: $18.69 DD/UE vs $11.99 allmenus; 34. Hunter Pence: $21.19 vs $13.11; 98. Jaymee Sirewich: $17.44 vs $11.99) - ratios scattered 1.36x-1.81x across 23 matched items, not a clean single multiplier, so no way to divide out a fixed fee. allmenus alone is tier 5 and needs a second independent priced source to trust, which is not available. Own site (ikessandwich.com) has no first-party web ordering (app/in-store only per its own "online ordering coming soon" page). No dine-in artefact reachable within budget.

name: Thai Island@
blocked: no-priced-source-reached: Facebook page (only listed website) returns HTTP 400 on fetch. Its apparent own ordering site, thai-island.res-menu.net, returns HTTP 200 with a 0-byte body on both / and /menu (host answers but serves nothing to curl or WebFetch, which got 403); did not have time budget to test whether res-menu.net is down site-wide vs just this restaurant. A toasttab.com link found in search ("thai-island-restaurant-711-palm-ave") carries a different street address (711 Palm Ave) and was not used - likely a different Thai Island location. thai-island.cafes-world.com is a templated directory-farm domain (same family as barred cafes-guide.com) and was not trusted. No DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub listing found for this address (1134 7th Ave, San Diego).

name: Mille Fleurs
notes: First-party Wix site, address confirmed exactly (6009 Paseo Delicias, Rancho Santa Fe, CA 92067; menu dated "as of September 3, 2026" on the page). The site publishes only one price on the entire menu: a single $60 four-course prix-fixe covering all of Dinner (and, per its own tab structure, Dessert and Lunch). Every individual dish in the underlying Wix Restaurants Menus app JSON carries priceInfo.price: "0" (checked all ~35 items across all sections) - there is no per-item price anywhere, only the flat prix-fixe figure. This matches the fine-dining "prices only the tasting menu" case; no itemised menu exists to capture.

name: Salsa Mexican Food
blocked: implausible-price-level: DoorDash JSON-LD (91 items, address-confirmed 1530 Main St) prices tacos at $1.25-$2.10, burritos mostly $3.85-$6.45, tortas flat at $3.95 - well below any plausible 2026 San Diego County price level (a WebSearch summary for the same restaurant separately quoted Carne Asada Burrito $16.99 and Beef Chimichanga Combo $20.99, roughly 3-4x higher, though that summary was not independently verified against a live page). Cent distribution (10:4,15:17,25:4,35:1,40:3,45:4,50:1,55:3,65:2,75:7,80:1,85:21,90:3,95:20) is internally conventional and no divisor (1.04-1.30) explains it as a fee (best fit only 27% at 1.10), so this reads as a stale/outdated cached catalog rather than a markup - the cheaper source is the old one. Aggregator sites found (food-menu.net, restaurants-us.com, roostcafeandbistro.com) are templated multi-restaurant directory farms and were not trusted. Own site not found (router: no website).

name: BKK THAI KITCHEN
blocked: markup-confirmed: Own site (bkkthaikitchen.com/menu) lists full item names and descriptions for every section (Appetizers, Entrees, Curries, etc.) but publishes zero base prices anywhere - only protein/upgrade surcharges ("Add $1.00 for Vegetables...$2.00 for Chicken...$3.00 for Shrimp/Beef/Squid"), no anchor price for the dish itself. Fell back to DoorDash (address-confirmed 1818 Marron Rd): divisor sweep found 79/91 items (87%) land on an exact whole dollar when divided by 1.10, and 83/91 (91%) on a whole-or-half-dollar - a clean 10% fee baked into the storefront (e.g. BKK Sample $17.60/1.10=$16.00, Chicken Satay $8.80/1.10=$8.00, Tom Kha $17.60/1.10=$16.00). Held per the markup rule; not divided out.

name: Palomino's Mexican & Seafood
blocked: implausible-price-level: Facebook (only listed website) returns HTTP 400. UberEats catalogSectionsMap (address-confirmed 2615 Sweetwater Springs Blvd, 123 items across 16 sections) prices tacos at $2.65-$3.40, burritos mostly $3.70-$6.55, min item $0.55, max $10.55 - implausibly low for a 2026 sit-down Mexican-seafood restaurant. Cent distribution is scattered across nearly every ending (.00/.05/.10/.15/.20/.25/.30/.35/.40/.50/.55/.59/.60/.65/.70/.80/.85/.90/.95/.99) with no divisor (1.04-1.50 tested) explaining more than 18% of items as a fee, so this does not read as a markup either - it reads as a stale, long-uncached catalog. gotoeat.net (a barred directory farm) and a templated menu-world.com listing turned up in search and were not used. No dine-in artefact or first-party site reachable within budget.

name: Theos Hot Pizza
notes: No usable own site (theoshotpizza.com routes to a browser-only POS widget per the work-list router note).
